news.quote: announced an agreement to acquire Mosaic's Faustina ammonia production plant in St. James, Louisiana, along with its storage and logistics infrastructure

touches.claim: CF Industries operates the world's largest ammonia production network, supported by an extensive North American storage, transportation, and distribution network.

CF Industries compounds nutrient production per share via capacity expansion and share repurchases, having increased production capacity 36% and decreased share count 58% since 2010 to reach 55 annual nitrogen equivalent tons per 1,000 shares outstanding as of September 30, 2026, with a 2030F target of 63.

Achieving the 2030F target of 63 annual nitrogen equivalent tons per 1,000 shares requires delivering CF's 40% share of Blue Point capacity on time at nameplate capacity, executing the ~$1.1B remaining under the $2B share repurchase program expiring December 2029, and sustaining ~60% average conversion of Adjusted EBITDA to free cash flow.

news.why: CF Industries agreed to buy Mosaic's Faustina ammonia plant and related storage and logistics assets in Louisiana for $600 million (including $360 million in cash), which expands its North American ammonia and logistics network and capacity growth while deploying capital alongside its Blue Point build and share repurchase program without disclosed asset capacity or earnings terms.

business_model.claim: CF Industries manufactures anhydrous ammonia using the Haber-Bosch process with atmospheric nitrogen and natural gas, selling ammonia directly or upgrading it into nitrogen fertilizers and industrial products.
quotes: We use the Haber-Bosch process to fix atmospheric nitrogen with hydrogen from natural gas to produce ammonia, whose chemical composition is NH3.
We sell the ammonia itself or upgrade it to products such as granular urea, UAN and DEF.

business_model.claim: Its fertilizer products derived from ammonia include granular urea, UAN, and AN (which is also used in commercial explosives), while industrial upgraded products include DEF, urea liquor, nitric acid, and aqua ammonia.
quotes: Products derived from ammonia, or upgraded products, that are most often used as nitrogen fertilizers include granular urea, urea ammonium nitrate solution (UAN) and ammonium nitrate (AN).
AN is also used extensively by the commercial explosives industry as a component of explosives.
Upgraded products that are sold primarily to industrial customers include diesel exhaust fluid (DEF), urea liquor, nitric acid and aqua ammonia.

business_model.claim: The company sells to cooperatives, retailers, independent fertilizer distributors, traders, wholesalers, and industrial users, and has a supply agreement giving CHS Inc. the right to purchase annually up to approximately 1.1 million tons of granular urea and 580,000 tons of UAN at market prices.
quotes: Our principal customers are cooperatives, retailers, independent fertilizer distributors, traders, wholesalers and industrial users.

CHS also receives deliveries pursuant to a supply agreement under which CHS has the right to purchase annually from CFN up to approximately 1.1 million tons of granular urea and 580,000 tons of UAN at market prices.

business_model.claim: The company offers forward sales programs where customers make an initial cash down payment and pay the balance before shipment, reducing working capital needs and fixing selling prices in advance.
quotes: Under our forward sales programs, customers generally make an initial cash down payment at the time of order and pay the remaining portion of the contract sales value in advance of the shipment date.

Our forward sales improve our liquidity by reducing our working capital needs due to the upfront cash payments received from customers and facilitate more efficient production planning and utilization of our manufacturing and distribution assets.
